violation_type.title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))
violation_type.typical_finding: The Admission Information Form 2935 has not been updated with the information on a child s ability to swim without assistance.

finding_variants.text: The Admission Information Form 2935 has not been updated with the information on a child s ability to swim without assistance.
Four children files out of four reviewed is missing the child s ability to swim without assistance documentation required by the new admission forms.
The current required documentation on water play and inclusion was not available for review in the parent handbook or admission information.
Ten children files out of ten reviewed is missing the child s ability to swim without assistance documentation required by the new admission forms.
Six child records did not have information in the file regarding the child being able to swim without assistance.
All required admission information was not available for review.
